ideas.pitch: An AI-powered spatial monitoring and crowdsourced reporting platform for campus safety in Atlanta, utilizing satellite and GIS mapping to highlight poorly lit pedestrian routes.
ideas.title: Atlanta Campus Safety & Lighting Audit Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying spatial intelligence to a real-world civic and campus safety problem, appealing directly to institutional judges at GSU.

ideas.pitch: A personalized meal planning and wellness app tailored specifically to campus dining hall menus and local student budgets in Atlanta.
ideas.title: Student Health & Campus Dining Nutrition Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the success of E-Foodiee by focusing on hyper-localized, highly practical personal health use cases that resonate immediately with student and faculty judges.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent academic advisor and student support ecosystem using LangGraph and RAG to help students navigate course prerequisites, financial aid deadlines, and department requirements.
ideas.title: GSU Student Support Multi-Agent RAG Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the winning formula of greennovation-ai-platform to solve administrative friction points specific to large universities like GSU.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace facilitating micro-transactions and escrow for student entrepreneurs and local Atlanta makers.
ideas.title: Atlanta Local Vendor Autonomous Micro-Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the technical execution pattern of Dispatch by building agent-driven commerce workflows that showcase complex state management and payment logic.

ideas.pitch: A predictive forecasting dashboard using Poisson regression and statistical modeling to anticipate maintenance bottlenecks and facility incidents across campus buildings.
ideas.title: Campus Incident & Maintenance Forecasting Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs rigorous predictive modeling and data calibration similar to the ai-incident-forecasting winner, proving technical depth beyond a simple wrapper.
